The page contradicts itself: the infobox disestablishes Nan Sarunai in 1389 and has Majapahit vassalage 1354-1389, while the text says the kingdom 'fell in 1362'; the dossier ends at 1362 so that it does not overlap Negara Dipa (founded 1380 or 1387 per the Dipa page). The majapahit dossier should carry Nan Sarunai as a vassal from 1354 and the gain in 1362; it does not mention either. Hulu Sungai Utara is not an admin1; the disc is the researcher's.
